normative_extracts.quote: The fetchpriority attribute provides a hint to the user agent about the relative priority of the fetch.

engine_internals.mechanism_summary: fetchpriority adjusts resource priority before the first Layout pass.

production_failures.mitigation: Restrict fetchpriority='high' to the single LCP element.
